name: FraudCase
description: Aggregate root for an APP fraud investigation under PSR PS23/3. Created by SVC-013 (Fraud Detection) on either a real-time payment block (trigger_type = realtime_block, sourced from PaymentFraudBlocked EVT-186) or a customer fraud report (trigger_type = customer_report). Tracks the full investigation lifecycle from creation through to closure. Acts as the parent for FraudEvidence (ENT-044) and the trigger source for ReimbursementClaim (ENT-045). Retained in WORM storage (SVC-111) for 7 years from case closure (NFR-005-DATA-001). Introduced by JRN-005.

fields.name: case_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: case_reference
fields.validation_rule: System-generated human-readable reference. Format: APP-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX (date + 6-digit zero-padded sequence). Immutable. Used in all customer-facing communications.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001, SVC-001). Denormalised for audit query efficiency. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004, SVC-001). The account from which the fraudulent payment was made. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: payment_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK reference → PaymentIntent.payment_intent_id (ENT-008, SVC-001). Cross-service reference only — SVC-013 reads PaymentIntent via SVC-001 API. Null if no payment identified.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: realtime_block | customer_report. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: fraud_typology
fields.validation_rule: Required for customer_report. Enum: impersonation_bank | impersonation_police | impersonation_hmrc | investment_fraud | romance_fraud | purchase_fraud | invoice_fraud | advance_fee_fraud | other.

fields.name: reported_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Start of 5-business-day PSR SLA clock. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: assigned_analyst
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Staff user identifier for PER-054 (Fraud Analyst). Must be set within 4 hours of reported_date (NFR-005-REG-002).

fields.name: assigned_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. SLA metric: assigned_at minus reported_date must be <= 4 hours P99.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: open | investigating | decision_pending | reimbursed | partially_reimbursed | declined | closed. Transitions via state machine. Terminal state: closed.

fields.name: total_loss_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. 0.00 for realtime_block. Max 2 decimal places.

fields.name: reimbursement_amount
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. GBP. Min 0.01. Max 85000.00 (PSR cap). Set at PH-067. Null for declined.

fields.name: reimbursement_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set by SVC-001 via ReimbursementCredited event. SLA: <= 5 business days from reported_date.

fields.name: decision_outcome
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Enum: approved | partial | declined. Set at PH-067. Immutable after setting.

fields.name: decision_rationale
fields.validation_rule: Required at PH-067. Min 50 chars. Max 5,000 chars. Stored encrypted at rest. Access: PER-054, PER-059, PER-052 only.

fields.name: gross_negligence_evidence
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when decision_outcome = declined. Min 100 chars. Stored encrypted. Must meet PSR PS23/3 evidential standard.

fields.name: contributory_negligence_percentage
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when decision_outcome = partial. Integer 1-99.

fields.name: vulnerability_assessment
fields.validation_rule: Required. JSON array. Values: none_identified | financial_difficulty | bereavement | mental_health | elderly | under_duress | other. Mandatory for every case (PSR PS23/3).

fields.name: vulnerability_detail
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required if vulnerability_assessment != [none_identified]. Max 1,000 chars. Encrypted. UK GDPR Article 9(2)(f) lawful basis for special category data.

fields.name: senior_manager_sign_off
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. Must be true before POST /decision when reimbursement_amount > 25000 OR decision = decline.

fields.name: senior_manager_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when senior_manager_sign_off = true. Immutable after setting.

fields.name: sar_referred
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. POCA 2002 s333A boundary: field indicates referral occurred; no SAR content stored here.

fields.name: stop_clock_active
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. PER-059 authorisation required to set true. PSR PS23/3 stop-the-clock provision.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. WORM 7-year retention clock starts from this timestamp.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every status transition.

relationships.description: FraudCase belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK. Read via SVC-001 API.
FraudCase belongs to one Account via account_id FK.
FraudCase references one PaymentIntent via payment_intent_id FK (cross-service reference to SVC-001).
FraudCase has zero or more FraudEvidence records.
FraudCase has at most one ReimbursementClaim (created by SVC-009 on FraudReimbursementApproved).
